Fort Collins's technology and manufacturing sector drives steady demand for certified project managers. content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Collins

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—which combine formal education with verifiable hours managing projects—to ensure you meet the baseline. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify whether your background qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions from your Fort Collins location on a schedule that fits your work commitments. This formal instruction covers the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains required by PMI.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the course, apply directly to PMI with proof of your contact hours and project experience. Pay the associated PMI exam fee. Granite PM Academy will provide documentation of your training completion to support your application.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your exam when you feel ready. Granite PM Academy's support continues through your test date to build confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning the PMP, you must earn professional development units (PDUs) across a standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training and resources to help you meet PMI's continuing-education requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.

While not universally required, certification typically strengthens your positioning for advancement and competitive offers, especially if you're managing structured, cross-functional delivery in these industries.
